title_en: Yazid ibn Mu'awiya in the Thought of Ibn Taymiyya
summary: In this lecture, His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari examines the views and thought of Ibn Taymiyya regarding Yazid ibn Mu'awiya within the framework of Umayyad Islam.
series_en: Muṭarahat fi al-Aqida - Ma'alim al-Islam al-Umawi
